t: Updated: Kroger Introduces Simple Truth™ and Simple Truth Organic® Brands; Available Exclusively at Kroger's Family of Stores
s: June 30, 2018 - "While organic products are available in most conventional grocery stores, our customers told us that labels can be confusing, and there's a general belief in the marketplace that organic means more expensive," said Mary Ellen Adcock, Vice President of Natural Foods for Kroger. "At Kroger we understand these challenges, so we're offering our shoppers the Simple Truth Organic brand, an easy, more clearly labeled and affordable way to buy organic products."
